title: Easy Valve Filling Pad Set 2 Pack
description:
The Filling Pad can be used as “gap filler” in order to avoid small amounts of herbs swirling around in the Filling Chamber. In addition, the Filling Pad can also be used as a carrier of very finely ground herbs so that the small particles don’t fall through the holes of the Filling Chamber.

Also can be used for essential oils and concentrates

Compatible with:
VOLCANO HYBRID
VOLCANO DIGIT
VOLCANO CLASSIC
PLENTY
EASY VALVE
